body_lead: BENGALURU: Chief Secretary Shalini Rajneesh on Tuesday said that the state government is working towards AI-enabled governance and not merely positioning Karnataka as an innovation hub for AI. Speaking after inaugurating the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Centre of Excellence (CoE) implementation workshop here, she said, “The state has taken significant steps to institutionalise AI within governance systems.
